name: vibe-testing
description: Code-aware browser testing for AI coding agents.
long_description: Read the app's routes and forms, run browser checks with Playwright, compare runs, and produce an evidence-backed QA report. The server makes no LLM calls and needs no API key.

tools.name: scan_codebase
tools.description: Map routes, forms, existing tests, coverage gaps, and test scenarios.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Create an authenticated browser session for later checks.

tools.name: scan_page_elements
tools.description: List interactive elements and capture the current page.

tools.name: explore_page
tools.description: Exercise page controls and record UI and API behavior.

tools.name: execute_scenario
tools.description: Run one browser scenario with step logs and screenshots.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Return route coverage, gaps, and suggested checks.

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Create a self-contained HTML QA report.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a route with optional authentication.

tools.name: suggest_tests
tools.description: Prioritize test scenarios from code and coverage evidence.

tools.name: run_full_test
tools.description: Scan the app, run generated scenarios, and write a report.

tools.name: run_converge
tools.description: Repeat testing and compare the current run with the previous run.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Return current session, product-model, and result state.

tools.name: cleanup
tools.description: Close browser sessions and release test resources.
